exclusions: No guarantee of citizenship or documentation approval; no Task Force interference with statutory discretion; no linkage to the household poverty record without separate lawful authority and consent
delivery_channel: JPN one-stop desks; mobile registration teams; case-management and lawful referral through existing JPN decision routes
geographic_coverage: All states and federal territories through 15 proposed desks, subject to JPN capacity confirmation
annual_volume: 15 proposed desks; annual case throughput cannot be set until the opening caseload and cycle-time baseline is accepted
complaints_and_appeals: JPN complaint channel plus a documented case-status review and escalation route; review concerns process and reasons, not substitution for the competent decision-maker
data_collected: Applicant identity and contact data; application category; submitted evidence; procedural status; decision category and reasons; service timestamps
retention_and_access_rule: Dataset-specific schedule under LGL-09 to LGL-11; minimum necessary access; documentation data kept separate from PRG-09; retention period, correction, disclosure and deletion rules require written approval
key_dependencies: VAL-06; VAL-12; legal-aid capacity; JPN staffing and system access; LGL-04; LGL-09 to LGL-11; FIS-04; FIS-05
stop_criteria: Stop intake expansion if JPN lacks lawful access, authorised staff, secure case controls or a functioning escalation route; suspend any data linkage not expressly authorised
redesign_criteria: Redesign volumes, desk footprint and service standards after VAL-12; remove any service commitment that fetters discretion or exceeds verified capacity
expansion_criteria: Expand only after verified throughput and cycle-time improvement, secure data controls, JPN capacity acceptance and an approved costed staffing model

exclusions: No guaranteed preschool place; no duplicate subsidy; no ethnicity-only eligibility rule; no payment to unregistered providers
delivery_channel: Referral through schools and community channels into MOE, KEMAS, PERPADUAN and registered private preschool platforms; subsidy, transport and meal support through an approved inter-agency protocol
geographic_coverage: National, phased by district-level eligible cohort and verified registered-provider capacity
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 6,400 places per year in Phase 1, 11,200 in Phase 2 and 12,800 in Phase 3
complaints_and_appeals: Lead-provider complaint channel plus MOE review for eligibility, duplicate-assistance or payment errors; written reason and onward referral where another provider is responsible
data_collected: Child and guardian identifiers; age; household-income evidence or approved alternative assessment; provider; attendance; assistance received; readiness assessment
retention_and_access_rule: Minimum necessary child record; role-based provider access; no sharing beyond approved enrolment, payment and evaluation purposes; retention and correction schedule requires MOE and data-governance approval
key_dependencies: VAL-09; district provider capacity; inter-agency subsidy protocol; LGL-02; LGL-07; FIS-05; FIS-08
stop_criteria: Do not launch in a district without verified provider capacity, lawful eligibility rules, duplicate-payment controls and an approved payment route
redesign_criteria: Recalibrate cohort, participation, support mix and unit cost after VAL-09 and provider market testing
expansion_criteria: Expand only where enrolment and readiness evidence shows need, provider quality and capacity are verified, and Treasury accepts the added component cost

exclusions: No presumption that national dilapidated-school funds are available; no works before condition, land, procurement and funding checks; no automatic equal grant per school
delivery_channel: MOE-led condition audit; PWD technical assessment and works route; state education departments, boards and PIBG support; MITRA limited to confirmed eligible equipment
geographic_coverage: All 528 SJKT nationally; works prioritised by audited safety risk and lawful site access
annual_volume: Phase 1: 528 audits; central model assumes approximately 158 schools remediated across six years, with annual works volume set only after the audit
complaints_and_appeals: MOE school-works complaint channel with recorded technical review, prioritisation reason and procurement-integrity escalation; safety emergencies follow existing statutory channels
data_collected: School identity; site and tenure status; condition and risk rating; works scope; procurement, contractor and payment record; completion certification; digital-facility status
retention_and_access_rule: Institutional works records only; role-based access; public reporting aggregated except for published works schedules; retention follows approved MOE/PWD works and procurement schedules
key_dependencies: VAL-11; completed condition audit; land/site authority; PWD capacity; LGL-08; FIS-05; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Stop works at any site lacking lawful access, technical certification, approved procurement route or funding; suspend contractor for integrity or safety breach
redesign_criteria: Reprioritise scope and reprice after the 528-school audit and VAL-11; remove components already funded elsewhere
expansion_criteria: Expand beyond safety-critical works only after audit evidence, completion performance, verified capacity and a Treasury-approved rolling works plan

exclusions: No worship, proselytisation, ceremony, devotional fixture or doctrinal expenditure; no federal decision on title, relocation or religious governance; no work without facility-specific consent
delivery_channel: JPNIN-coordinated facility mapping and audit; state, local, fire, works and religious-authority approvals; matched grant for eligible safety works; legacy matters documented for referral only
geographic_coverage: Opt-in by state and institution; facility- and jurisdiction-specific clearance, with non-consenting or uncleared jurisdictions excluded
annual_volume: Central planning assumption: up to 1,200 audits and approximately 400 priority safety-work grants over six years; no annual commitment before the multi-faith map
complaints_and_appeals: Published eligibility and works-review channel through the Ministry of National Unity; facility may seek reasoned reconsideration; jurisdictional or religious questions referred to the competent state body
data_collected: Institution profile and public-service function; governing regime needed for routing; consent; safety and accessibility findings; works, grant and referral status; no beneficiary religious-affiliation data
retention_and_access_rule: Institution-level minimum data only; no worshipper or beneficiary faith data; disclosure, retention and publication rules require LGL-18 clearance; state-specific sharing protocol applies
key_dependencies: VAL-13; LGL-12 to LGL-18; facility and state consent; verified facility map; contractor and partner capacity; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Exclude or stop any facility without all competent consents, lawful public purpose, approved expenditure category, procurement controls or safe delivery route
redesign_criteria: Redesign by jurisdiction and institution type after the facility map; separate or remove any pathway that cannot be lawfully administered
expansion_criteria: Expand only jurisdiction by jurisdiction after written clearance, consent, verified demand, completed pilot works, audit acceptance and a Treasury-approved grant ceiling

exclusions: No admission guarantee; no alteration of institutional selection criteria; no unsupported destination target
delivery_channel: School-based career profiling and application clinics with follow-through through MOE, MOHE and TVET admissions interfaces
geographic_coverage: Participating secondary schools nationally, prioritised after the cohort and destination baseline
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 20,000 students supported per year; volume is provisional pending VAL-14
complaints_and_appeals: MOE school-guidance complaint channel plus application-error review and no-wrong-door referral to the institution controlling the relevant application
data_collected: Student contact and school data; pathway preferences; application milestones; offers, acceptance and confirmed destination; limited household-income band for prioritisation
retention_and_access_rule: Minimum necessary education-transition record; approved MOE/MOHE/TVET sharing agreement; defined correction and retention schedule before longitudinal tracking
key_dependencies: VAL-14; MOE/MOHE/TVET data-sharing; school counsellor capacity; LGL-05; FIS-05
stop_criteria: Stop publication of outcome claims if destination matching is incomplete or materially biased; do not operate a pathway without a responsible receiving agency
redesign_criteria: Recalibrate school coverage, counsellor workload and volume after the first official cohort and destination series
expansion_criteria: Expand only after verified application completion and destination data demonstrate benefit and participating agencies confirm capacity

exclusions: No guaranteed certification, apprenticeship or employment; no duplicate payment for training already funded by HRD Corp or another scheme
delivery_channel: Existing accredited TVET and STEM providers; completion stipend through an approved payment route; employer-linked apprenticeships; tracked certification and employment verification
geographic_coverage: National, phased by verified provider seats and employer demand by sector and region
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 2,500 entrants per year in Phase 1, 5,000 in Phase 2 and 7,500 in Phase 3
complaints_and_appeals: Provider complaint and assessment-appeal channel plus ministry escalation for stipend, placement or tracking errors; employment disputes remain with competent labour channels
data_collected: Participant eligibility and contact data; training, attendance, stipend, assessment and certification record; apprenticeship; consented employment verification and wage band
retention_and_access_rule: Provider-to-ministry data schedule; minimum necessary employment matching; defined access, correction, retention and deletion rules before EPF or SOCSO matching
key_dependencies: VAL-15; accredited seat supply; employer commitments; LGL-02; LGL-07; FIS-05; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Stop new cohorts where accredited seats, stipend funding, safeguarding, employer placements or tracking capacity are not confirmed; stop a provider for material quality or integrity breach
redesign_criteria: Reduce sector, regional or cohort scope to verified capacity; revise stipend, apprenticeship and outcome design after early-cohort evidence
expansion_criteria: Expand only after completion, placement and wage outcomes are verified, employer demand persists and unit costs and capacity are accepted

exclusions: No additional seat, sub-quota, offer or admission guarantee; no change to the 90:10 framework; no publication of unverified intake claims
delivery_channel: MOE publication of the official intake and offer series; applicant navigation through existing matriculation and pre-university application channels
geographic_coverage: National applicant service, with outreach prioritised by verified procedural attrition and household need
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 10,000 applicants supported per year; recalibration required after VAL-05
complaints_and_appeals: MOE applicant-support channel for procedural errors and status questions; written referral to the institution controlling the decision; no merits appeal outside existing admission rules
data_collected: Applicant qualification and contact data; pathway and application status; offer, acceptance and enrolment outcome; support interaction
retention_and_access_rule: Minimum necessary admissions-navigation record; approved cross-institution sharing and publication rules; retention and correction schedule before launch
key_dependencies: VAL-05; official data definitions; MOE/MOHE cooperation; LGL-02; LGL-07; FIS-05; FIS-08
stop_criteria: Stop any seat or conversion claim not supported by the accepted official series; suspend navigation where staff lack authorised system access
redesign_criteria: Redesign support around the verified attrition point and remove any representation that implies reserved places
expansion_criteria: Expand only after sustained official publication, verified procedural-loss reduction and confirmed service capacity

exclusions: No guaranteed professional placement, licensing outcome or employment; no reliance on unvetted mentors
delivery_channel: MOHE-coordinated mentor network through universities, professional bodies and employers; structured matching, preparation and placement brokerage
geographic_coverage: Phase 2 launch in participating institutions and fields with verified mentor supply; national expansion is conditional
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 1,250 graduates mentored per year in Phases 2 and 3
complaints_and_appeals: Programme complaint and rematching channel; safeguarding escalation; licensing and employment decisions remain with the competent professional body or employer
data_collected: Graduate profile and consent; field and qualification; mentor eligibility and matching; interactions; placement and tracer outcome
retention_and_access_rule: Minimum necessary mentoring record; safeguarding access controls; partner data agreement; retention, correction and deletion schedule approved before matching
key_dependencies: VAL-16; signed partner commitments; mentor eligibility and safeguarding protocol; LGL-10; FIS-05
stop_criteria: Stop matching where mentor vetting, safeguarding, consent, supervision or complaint handling fails; suspend a partner for material breach
redesign_criteria: Pilot by field and institution; reduce ratio or geography to available qualified mentors and redesign low-supply fields
expansion_criteria: Expand only after mentor supply, safe operation, participant retention and tracer outcomes are independently verified

exclusions: Navigators do not approve benefits or replace agency decisions; no compulsory enrolment; no linkage to PRG-01 documentation records
delivery_channel: Consent-based referral and case coordination through a proposed JPM delivery secretariat and named progression navigators, using existing agency programmes
geographic_coverage: National phased service through approved state or regional entry points; exact footprint subject to establishment and caseload validation
annual_volume: Central planning capacity: 120 navigators and 18,000 concurrent households in Phase 1; 280 and 42,000 in Phase 2; 400 and 60,000 in Phase 3
complaints_and_appeals: Named case owner; status visibility; written referral or closure reason; lead-secretariat complaint and escalation route; benefit decisions reviewed only by the responsible statutory agency
data_collected: Household identity and contact; consent; barrier and referral taxonomy; service interactions; agency status; limited outcome measures across income, employment, savings and housing
retention_and_access_rule: Separate consent-based household record; no documentation-case linkage; purpose-specific role access; retention, correction, withdrawal and deletion rules require DPIA and approval under LGL-09 to LGL-11
key_dependencies: VAL-17; VAL-23; VAL-25; navigator establishment and training; agency referral agreements; LGL-09 to LGL-11; FIS-04; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Stop enrolment if establishment, DPIA, consent, secure system, referral commitments or complaint route is absent; pause exits where premature graduation risk is detected
redesign_criteria: Recalibrate caseload, barrier taxonomy, service footprint and progression rules after the opening baseline and pilot evaluation
expansion_criteria: Expand only after safe caseload performance, accepted outcome evidence, agency capacity and an approved recurrent staffing ceiling

exclusions: No new lending facility; no procurement set-aside, quota, award guarantee or preferential bid treatment; no duplication of SME Corp or TEKUN advisory
delivery_channel: Structured advisory through SME Corp and existing enterprise-development rails; certification, consortium and bid-readiness support; procurement outcomes measured only
geographic_coverage: Phase 2 launch through participating SME Corp and ministry channels; geographic allocation follows verified enterprise demand and provider capacity
annual_volume: Reconciled central planning case: approximately 5,000 enterprises over Phases 2 and 3, or about 1,250 per year
complaints_and_appeals: Provider complaint channel plus ministry review for eligibility, service quality or certification error; procurement challenges remain within the applicable procurement review mechanism
data_collected: Enterprise identity, ownership and registration; capability assessment; service and certification record; consented revenue, employment and procurement-outcome data
retention_and_access_rule: Commercially sensitive data minimised and role-restricted; consented linkage only; partner retention and disclosure schedule approved before collection
key_dependencies: VAL-18; SME Corp delivery capacity; procurement-data access; LGL-08; LGL-10; FIS-05; FIS-08
stop_criteria: Stop any representation of reserved awards; stop or suspend a provider for conflict, related-party, integrity or material service-quality failure
redesign_criteria: Reconcile demand and provider capacity after VAL-18; change cohort size or service intensity to the validated unit cost without creating a financing scheme
expansion_criteria: Expand only after verified capability, survival or growth outcomes, provider capacity and lawful procurement-data reporting
signoff_owner: Secretary-General Ministry of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development

exclusions: No PNB commitment, product entitlement, investment return or universal match guarantee; no displacement of STR or SARA; no operation before MOF product approval
delivery_channel: MOF-approved matched-savings product through a willing regulated administrator; capped matching contribution and lock-in under an approved instrument
geographic_coverage: National only if a lawful product and administrator are confirmed; otherwise the programme does not launch
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 15,000 households enrolled in Phase 1, 35,000 cumulative by Phase 2 and 50,000 cumulative by Phase 3
complaints_and_appeals: Product administrator complaint and transaction-correction route plus MOF escalation; investment or product disputes follow the applicable regulated mechanism
data_collected: Participant identity, eligibility and consent; income band; contribution and match transactions; balance threshold and lock-in status
retention_and_access_rule: Financial data held by the approved administrator under applicable rules; government receives minimum necessary reporting; access, retention and disclosure schedule cleared before launch
key_dependencies: VAL-19; MOF instrument design; willing product administrator; LGL-07; LGL-10; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Do not launch without MOF approval, administrator agreement, capped liability, consumer safeguards, payment controls and an approved complaint route
redesign_criteria: Redesign product, match schedule, administrator or scale if PNB declines, exposure is unaffordable or take-up and persistence are weak
expansion_criteria: Expand only after verified take-up, saving persistence, consumer protection, capped fiscal exposure and Treasury approval

exclusions: No federal determination of land title, compensation or state housing entitlement; no construction cost for housing units in this programme; no state commitment without consent
delivery_channel: Federal legacy review and access facilitation; referral to state land and housing authorities; deposit and transaction support through existing affordable-housing, rent-to-own and SJKP routes; limited approved site infrastructure
geographic_coverage: Participating states and eligible sites only; state-specific route and capacity required
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 1,200 households by Year 2, 3,600 cumulative by Year 4 and 6,000 cumulative by Year 6
complaints_and_appeals: Written eligibility or referral reason; KPKT programme complaint channel; housing or land appeal proceeds through the competent state or scheme mechanism
data_collected: Household eligibility and contact; displacement or tenure evidence; referral and application status; assistance paid; housing or tenure outcome; site-level infrastructure record
retention_and_access_rule: Household data minimised and shared only under federal-state protocol; land records remain with competent authority; retention, correction and access schedule approved before referrals
key_dependencies: VAL-20; state participation and housing supply; site and land status; LGL-12; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Exclude any state, site or component lacking jurisdictional consent, lawful tenure route, verified housing capacity, approved payment route or safe works authority
redesign_criteria: Redesign state by state after the legacy review; separate access facilitation from unresolved land claims and reduce volumes to confirmed supply
expansion_criteria: Expand only with signed state route, verified housing capacity, completed assistance outcomes and approved fiscal exposure
signoff_owner: Secretary-General Ministry of Housing and Local Government

exclusions: No appointment, quota, panel seat or altered merit standard; no Task Force influence over Public Service Commission decisions
delivery_channel: JPA and SPA outreach, application guidance, examination and interview preparation, serving-officer mentoring and publication of application and composition data
geographic_coverage: National through participating schools, universities and community channels
annual_volume: Central planning case: approximately 4,000 candidates supported per year; recalibration required after VAL-21
complaints_and_appeals: Programme complaint channel for access or preparation quality; application-status or recruitment complaints follow SPA/JPA procedures; no merits substitution
data_collected: Candidate contact and eligibility; support participation; application stage and outcome; limited demographic data for lawful aggregate monitoring
retention_and_access_rule: HR and applicant data remain in authorised JPA/SPA systems; programme receives minimum necessary extracts; retention, access and publication schedule requires LGL-09 and LGL-11 clearance
key_dependencies: VAL-21; SPA/JPA data cooperation; LGL-03; LGL-09; LGL-11; FIS-04; FIS-05
stop_criteria: Stop any quota, appointment promise or unauthorised access to recruitment data; suspend outcome claims if the funnel denominator is incomplete
redesign_criteria: Target the verified attrition point after VAL-21; adjust outreach volume and preparation intensity to observed demand
expansion_criteria: Expand only after verified application growth, fair access, data integrity and JPA/SPA capacity acceptance

exclusions: No promotion guarantee, quota, service-commission direction or preferential standard; no claim of grade improvement before the baseline exists
delivery_channel: Access to existing INTAN, executive education, specialist training, cross-ministry exposure and mentoring; participation and grade-band outcomes monitored
geographic_coverage: Phase 2 across participating federal services and ministries, subject to JPA and service-commission boundaries
annual_volume: Annual participant volume cannot be set until VAL-22 and available programme capacity are accepted
complaints_and_appeals: JPA development-programme complaint channel; selection reason and referral to the responsible service authority; promotion appeals remain under existing service rules
data_collected: Officer grade and scheme; eligibility; programme application and participation; mentoring; aggregate career progression outcome
retention_and_access_rule: Authoritative HR data remains in HRMIS; programme uses minimum necessary role-controlled extracts; retention and publication schedule requires LGL-09 and LGL-11 clearance
key_dependencies: VAL-22; JPA/INTAN capacity; LGL-03; LGL-09; LGL-11; FIS-04; FIS-05
stop_criteria: Stop any representation of promotion entitlement or unauthorised personal HR disclosure; pause expansion if participation is not merit-based and auditable
redesign_criteria: Set volume and field mix after the grade-band baseline; redesign around verified access barriers rather than assumed promotion bias
expansion_criteria: Expand only after baseline publication, fair selection, verified participation and capacity, and evidence of development value

exclusions: No takeover of ministry, statutory-body, service-commission, state, MITRA or accounting-officer powers; no permanent establishment or personal PM-chairing commitment is assumed; routine delivery may not be paused solely because a political meeting is postponed
delivery_channel: Cabinet-authorised governance chain under GC-01 to GC-08: Prime Ministerial sponsorship and strategic review; designated responsible minister; Chief Secretary-chaired or authorised-equivalent senior-officials committee; named ministry delivery officers and alternates; bounded JPM secretariat; automatic escalation; meeting-independent reporting; office-based succession
geographic_coverage: Whole-of-government coordination; no direct beneficiary delivery footprint
annual_volume: Central design assumption: 35 secretariat posts; monthly senior-officials review and quarterly strategic review and reporting cycles; neither the posts nor the permanent bodies are authorised or fiscally confirmed
complaints_and_appeals: Automatic exception register and tiered escalation for missed milestones; external channel for dashboard or reporting complaints; substantive service complaints remain with the accountable programme owner
data_collected: Meeting, decision, delegation, nomination, action, milestone, exception, handover, risk and programme-performance records; no unnecessary beneficiary case data
retention_and_access_rule: Secretariat holds aggregate or authorised programme extracts only; access, archival, disclosure and retention follow approved Cabinet, records and data-governance instruments; dashboard cut-off and publication do not depend on meeting occurrence
key_dependencies: VAL-08; VAL-23; VAL-27; GC-01 to GC-08; Cabinet terms of reference; LGL-05 to LGL-08; FIS-04; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Do not establish or incur expenditure without Cabinet, establishment, legal and fiscal authority; stop any attempted exercise of a retained statutory power; activate succession and escalation controls if an office or review fails
redesign_criteria: Redesign hosting, staffing, delegation, reporting or escalation if Cabinet chooses a different model or if evidence shows that continuity controls, the 35-post model or reporting burden are not justified
expansion_criteria: Expand secretariat capacity only after workload evidence, reporting compliance, a continuity test, independent review and later establishment and funding approval

exclusions: No household-level system before DPIA and legal approval; no publication of unsafe small cells or unverified outcomes; no evaluator claim of executive authority
delivery_channel: DOSM-supported baseline; public dashboard; DPIA; independent mid-term and final evaluations; annual audit and reporting through authorised commissioning routes
geographic_coverage: National portfolio coverage, with state and programme disaggregation only where statistically and legally safe
annual_volume: Phase 1: one baseline survey, one dashboard and one DPIA; annual audit and reporting; one mid-term evaluation at end-Year 3 and one final evaluation in Year 6
complaints_and_appeals: Data-correction and publication-query channel; protected disclosure and audit escalation; programme-specific complaints remain with the relevant owner
data_collected: Approved indicator extracts; survey responses; programme outturns; audit and evaluation evidence; disclosure-risk metadata
retention_and_access_rule: Dataset register and DPIA define lawful purpose, minimum fields, access, linkage, retention, correction, deletion, breach and publication rules before collection
key_dependencies: VAL-24; evaluator and DOSM arrangements; dashboard specification; LGL-09 to LGL-11; FIS-05; FIS-08; FIS-09
stop_criteria: Stop collection or publication lacking an approved lawful basis, DPIA, secure transfer, statistical quality or disclosure control; suspend conflicted evaluator
redesign_criteria: Redesign indicators, survey, platform or disaggregation where baselines are infeasible, burdensome, unsafe or not decision-useful
expansion_criteria: Expand data scope only after necessity, quality, privacy, interoperability, cost and independent-governance tests are satisfied
